directive: Optimize quality-qualified end-to-end CPU tokens per second; ternary and base-3 are optional mechanisms, not the target.

changes: promote CPU throughput from side quest to primary objective
keep whole-model capability and honest byte accounting mandatory

tq2_0.classification: runtime ceiling only; rejected for catastrophic forgetting

direct_base3_vs_aligned2.decision: base-3 may be a portable storage encoding but may not be the hot compute layout

first_practical_baseline.purpose: measure the strongest immediately deployable CPU point below Q4 before judging custom mixed precision

research_candidate.name: activation-sensitive trained mixed aligned2
runtime_modes: aligned two-bit ternary for trained low-sensitivity bulk tensors
Q4 or Q6 for sensitive layers tensor families or activation modes
selection_evidence: measured end-to-end byte and wall-time contribution

stop_rules: raw full-model ternary PTQ cannot promote regardless of speed
microkernel speed cannot promote without a runnable whole-model consumer
teacher-forced error cannot replace free-generation capability gates
accuracy and throughput arms run alone on the measurement node
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
claim_boundary: Strategy and frozen promotion thresholds only; no Q3 or mixed-model result is claimed.
